card.name: Linking words in autoimmune and lymphoma lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (other, such, or, of, comma) inside lists of autoimmune diseases, lymphoma or malignancy terms, especially in immunosuppressant warnings.

modes.label: 'other' after lymphoma
modes.description: The word 'other' right after 'Lymphoma and' before 'malignancies'.
modes.example: Lymphoma and<< other>> malignancies, some fatal, have been

modes.label: Commas in autoimmune lists
modes.description: A comma between items in a list of autoimmune conditions.
modes.example: 5.5 Autoimmune Disorders Development or exacerbation of autoimmune disorders including myositis<<,>> hepatitis, thrombotic thromboc

modes.label: 'of' before lymphoma or malignancy
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'case' or 'history' just before a cancer or lymphoma term.
modes.example: treatment in patients with a history<< of>> malignancy or in continuing treatment in patients

card.writes: It seems to suppress words meaning 'a few' and promote immune and lymphoma-related terms, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words and commas just before the next autoimmune disease or lymphoma-type term in a warning list.
